templates.name: PolyMech 论文线图

style.page: Origin default 10.72 × 7.6 in (3216 × 2280 px at 300 dpi), as in the user's thesis figures
style.font: Times New Roman, bold; tick labels 20 pt, axis titles 28 pt, legend 22 pt (faces re-applied by the bridge after loading: Origin reloads template tick-label fonts as the preference default)
style.axes: 2.2 pt, black, closed frame; ticks out on bottom/left, in on top/right; major 9 pt, minor 4 pt, one minor between majors
style.legend: no frame; entries bold and live (%(n))
style.series_colors: set per plot by the job (thesis palette by series count)
